name: Project Wigglesworth
summary:
Swing, launch, and climb your way through a strange, ever-shifting laboratory in Project Wigglesworth—a quirky VR adventure powered by fast, Gorilla-style movement. Navigate broken lab equipment, scale towering machinery, and vault through corridors as you explore a place full of surprises and secrets.

The lab changes around you. Lights flicker, mist drifts through rooms, and the environment subtly shifts as you move, creating a world that feels alive and unpredictable.
